# `company.finance_charges`

Finance charges assessed on overdue customer balances, each written as a statement charge.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this finance charge record. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | transactions.id | Statement charge that put the finance charge on the account; the charge stands while it is posted. |
| `customer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_finance_charges_customer | customers.id | Customer or job charged. |
| `assessment_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | ix_finance_charges_customer | — | Date the charge was assessed as of and dated, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `overdue_balance_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Overdue balance the charge was computed on, in home-currency minor units. |
| `computed_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Charge as computed by the policy, minimum applied, before any change a person made. |
| `amount_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Charge actually assessed, in home-currency minor units. |
| `currency` | VARCHAR(3) | no | — | — | — | — | Home currency of the amounts. |
| `annual_rate` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Annual interest rate in percent the charge was computed at. |
| `grace_days` | INTEGER | no | — | — | — | — | Grace period in days the charge was computed with. |
| `calculated_from` | VARCHAR(12) | no | — | — | — | — | Whether days were counted from the due_date or the invoice_date. |
| `on_overdue_charges` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Whether earlier overdue finance charges were part of the balance. |
| `to_be_printed` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | Whether the charge was marked to be printed. |
| `basis` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Canonical JSON of the documents the charge was computed on: id, number, dates, open balance, days. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC timestamp the charge was assessed. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Principal who assessed it. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface it was assessed through. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the assessment that wrote it. |
